note: Since 2026-11-18 an agree verify row counts for export only when its claimed level is the binding's current level or above, so raising a binding needs a new agree at the new level. Before that rule an agree made at any level exported an L2 or L3 binding, and the bindings listed here exported that way on 2026-11-18 (main 89625cef7 and v1.10.0 03a0a0b58). This file keeps them exporting so that no addon or native feature that resolves them breaks: an entry is "<func|global|field|struct>:<name>" and the V-id of that lower-level agree, and it holds only while that agree is still the newest verify row over the binding. Any newer row ends it. The list only shrinks: binding.py ci and doctor fail a change that adds an entry or changes its V-id. Each blind agree at the binding's level removes its entry (binding.py baseline --prune drops the entries no longer in use).
